name: trustchain
description: TrustChain - transparent, milestone-based charity donations on Ethereum

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix blockchain install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix blockchain run compile && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix blockchain test && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
